rec.name: PDP Sticky Add-to-Cart Bar

what.text: A sticky add-to-cart bar on the product page. It shows the product image, title, price (with compare-at price and a 'You save X' badge) and variant selectors (color swatches or dropdowns), plus an Add to Cart button. It stays hidden until the buy box's own ATC button has scrolled out of view. On mobile it is fixed to the bottom of the screen. On desktop (1000px and wider) it sits directly below the header.

why.text: Keeps the primary call to action in reach during long product pages, so shoppers don't have to scroll back up to buy. Showing price, savings and variant choice in the bar keeps the key purchase information in view and cuts friction on mobile. Showing it only after the main button leaves the viewport avoids a redundant duplicate CTA.

how.text: 1) Add a 'Sticky Add to Cart' header and four checkboxes to the schema of the product section (main-product.liquid): enable, show title, show price, show variant selectors. 2) Inside the section, render the 'sticky-atc-button' snippet when the setting is on and the product is available. 3) Create the snippet sticky-atc-button.liquid with the markup, CSS and JS. The bar is hidden via CSS transform. An IntersectionObserver on the buy-box ATC button toggles the .active class once that button is out of view. The JS uses the product variants JSON to resolve the selected option combination, updates price, image and button state, and submits via AJAX to the cart. Header height is measured to position the bar on desktop. The variant:changed event handling must be adapted to each theme's variant-change logic. Written independently of the Focal theme, since the original Elbdev code was Focal-specific and not portable.

items: Enable/disable sticky add to cart on the PDP
Code constants to adapt: header selector, payment container ID, 'You save' label text, and the color swatch config setting

dependencies.text: Needs a product section (main-product.liquid or equivalent) in which to add the schema settings and the render call. The snippet assumes a product form with ID 'product-form-{section.id}-{product.id}', a header element selector, and theme translation keys product.form.add_to_cart and product.form.sold_out. It optionally uses the theme settings color_swatch_config, currency_code_enabled and icon_stroke_width, plus a 'color-swatch-style' snippet. Variant-change event hooks must be adapted per theme. The JS shown in the source is truncated, so the AJAX add-to-cart and variant URL sync logic could not be verified. The first developer struggled with AJAX add-to-cart and variant ID/URL switching. Not every theme has main-product.liquid, and the install docs were reworked to be theme-independent and beginner-friendly.
